title: [main]-Invalid SEPA export file format when SEPA Non-Euro Export enabled
summary: Fixes an invalid SEPA credit transfer export file that was produced when SEPA Non-Euro Export is enabled. The SEPA CT pain.001.001.09 xmlport was changed in several localization layers.
key_points: The SEPA CT pain.001.001.09 xmlport was modified in the BE, CH, ES, FR, IT, NL, NO and W1 layers
Fixes an invalid export file format when SEPA Non-Euro Export is enabled
SEPA credit transfer tests were added in several localization test layers
quote: Invalid SEPA export file format when SEPA Non-Euro Export enabled
